On this day in 1971, six emirates, including Abu Dhabi and Dubai, joined to form the United Arab Emirates.
On this day in 1967, a team led by Christiaan Barnard did the first human heart transplant in Cape Town, South Africa.
On this day in 1909, the Montreal Canadiens were founded, now the oldest professional ice hockey club still playing.
On this day in 1914, the Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition set off to try the first land crossing of Antarctica.
On this day in 1534, Spanish settlers led by Sebastian de Belalcazar founded the city of Quito in Ecuador.
On this day in 1936, Australian cricketer Jack Fingleton became the first to score centuries in four Test innings in a row.
On this day in 757, the poet Du Fu returned to Chang'an, the capital of Tang China, to serve at the emperor's court.
On this day in 1961, Tanganyika, today part of Tanzania, became independent from Britain.
On this day in 1932, Thailand became a constitutional monarchy.
On this day in 1958, Upper Volta (now Burkina Faso) and Dahomey (now Benin) gained self-government from France.
On this day in 2024, Gukesh Dommaraju of India became the youngest World Chess Champion in history, at a match in Singapore.
On this day in 1642, Abel Tasman became the first European known to see New Zealand.
On this day in 1911, Roald Amundsen and his team of four became the first people to reach the South Pole.
On this day in 1970, the Soviet spacecraft Venera 7 landed on Venus, the first soft landing on another planet.
On this day in 1972, the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh was enacted.
On this day in 1790, the Aztec calendar stone was discovered at the Zocalo, the main square of Mexico City.
On this day in 1878, the Al Thani family became the rulers of Qatar.
On this day in 1932, the BBC World Service began broadcasting, under the name BBC Empire Service.
On this day in 1999, Portugal handed Macau over to China.
On this day in 2012, festivals in Mesoamerica marked the end of a 5,126-year cycle of the Maya Long Count calendar.
On this day in 1851, India's first freight train ran in Roorkee, carrying material to build the Ganges Canal.
On this day in 583, the Maya queen Yohl Ik'nal was crowned ruler of the city of Palenque.
On this day in 1951, Libya became independent, with Idris I as its king.
On this day in 2021, the James Webb Space Telescope was launched into space.
On this day in 1898, Marie and Pierre Curie announced the discovery of radium.
On this day in 1911, Jana Gana Mana, the national anthem of India, was sung in public for the first time, in Calcutta.
On this day in 1768, Taksin was crowned king of Thailand and made Thonburi his capital.
On this day in 1911, Mongolia declared its independence from the Qing dynasty of China.
On this day in 1927, the Ginza Line, the first subway line in Asia, opened in Tokyo, Japan.
On this day in 1906, Mozaffar ad-Din Shah signed the Persian Constitution in what is now Iran.
